text: The purpose of this report is to advise of the results of the Request for Proposal (RFP) No. 9117-19-7037 for Program Management Assignment PM6A2 to provide professional engineering services for preliminary and detailed design, during construction and post-construction, to support the delivery of Toronto Water's coordinated 2020 to 2023 Standalone Watermain Replacement Program and to request the authority to enter into an agreement with R.V. Anderson Associated Limited (RVA) in the amount of $20,367,396, net of all taxes, $23,015,158 including HST and all applicable charges ($20,725,862 net of HST recoveries).

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. In accordance with Section 195-8.4A of the Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 195 (Purchasing By-Law), granted authority to the Chief Engineer and Executive Director, Engineering and Construction Services to negotiate and enter into an agreement with R.V. Anderson Associated Limited, being a successful proponent meeting the requirements of RFP No. 9117-19-7037 to provide Professional Engineering Services for Program Management, Engineering Services and Post Construction Services under Assignment PM6A2, to support Toronto Water's coordinated 2020 to 2023 Standalone Watermain Replacement Program at various locations across the City of Toronto, in the amount of $20,367,396, net of all taxes ($20,725,862 net of HST recoveries), including disbursements, provisional allowances and contingencies as follows: a.
